messages:
Iris: Quick thread to close the Apr-22 postmortem loop for customer comms. We need: short statuspage copy, 72h public summary, enterprise outreach plan, and a single-sentence RCA access policy. Also tie the recurrence pattern (KV cache evictions) to an owner.

Ben: I'll take statuspage copy. Keep it non-technical, two lines max.

Aria: I'll draft the 72h public summary (public audience) and include a short paragraph on the recurring pattern. ETA EOD 2024-04-26.

Noah: Enterprise outreach and private-briefing offer owned. I can have account templates and CS scripts by 2024-04-26 COB.

Suki: For RCA sharing: propose wording 1 "A redacted public summary is posted on our status page. Impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via Support; sensitive details may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Thoughts?

Iris: That sounds good. Ben, can you append a one-line link to support and reference the ticket? Also please avoid incident number mismatch — use the tracker INC-5032 which I just created.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-5032 created: "customer-rca-access-and-comms" assigned to Iris. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-5032

Ben: Draft statuspage snippet: ```
Status: Partial service disruption 1 Resolved
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced higher latency and errors. We mitigated the impact; service is operating normally. A public summary will be posted within 72 hours. To request a detailed RCA, contact Support (ref: INC-5032).
```

Suki: Tiny wording tweak: replace "errors" with "errors for some requests" and add sentence about NDA possibility. Updated suggestion: "...experienced higher latency and errors for some requests. Sensitive details may be shared under NDA."

Ben: Updated and pushed to staging. Target publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT after Legal quick-check.

Aria: 72h summary outline in doc: timeline, impact, mitigation, immediate mitigations for recurring pattern, next steps, how to request RCA. I'll flag anything Legal should redact.

Noah: Enterprise templates will include offer for private briefing and a suggested timeline to resolve account concerns. I'll include a link to request a briefing and template subject lines.

Iris: Recurring-incident ownership: Noah/SRE to open follow-up investigating quarterly KV cache eviction pattern and a mitigation plan. Can someone volunteer as SRE lead?

Noah: I'll coordinate with Platform SRE and nominate Mateo as lead. Plan ETA 2024-05-08.

Suki: Legal review note: NDA language must be reviewed; I'll send the policy blurb to Legal now. Expected feedback by 2024-04-28.

incident-bot: Action INC-5040 created: "recurrence-investigation-kv-evictions" assigned to Mateo. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-5040

Aria: 72h public summary ETA 2024-04-26 17:00 PT. I'll include a single line: "We will publish a redacted public RCA when appropriate; impacted customers can request a detailed report via Support (INC-5032)."

Iris: Action list for tracker:
- Statuspage copy: Ben -> publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT
- 72h public summary: Aria -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT
- Enterprise outreach & briefings: Noah -> 2024-04-26 COB
- RCA policy blurb/legal review: Suki -> legal signoff by 2024-04-28
- Recurrence mitigation plan: Mateo/SRE -> 2024-05-08

Ben: Will post staging preview link when ready.

Iris: Quick sync set for tomorrow 10:30 PT to sign off. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1748041800 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
